mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.fund_nm AS fundNm , '' AS workGb , TO_CHAR(t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.af_gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , t1.mg_cd AS secCd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SZM0IA t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.fund_cd IN (SELECT fund_cd FROM UZM0UI ta WHERE corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ymd = F_UZM0UI_YMD(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'))) AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd <= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') + 1) > TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') UNION ALL SELECT ia.corp_gr AS corpGr , ia.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , '결산' AS workGb , TO_CHAR(ia.bf_gyul_ymd + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfYmd , TO_CHAR(gi.gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , ia.mg_cd AS secCd , TO_CHAR(gi.gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SKT0GS gi , SZM0IA ia WHERE gi.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND gi.gyul_ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND F_OPEN_YMD(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), '+1') - 1 AND ia.corp_gr = gi.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = gi.fund_cd AND ia.fst_seolj_ymd <= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY secCd asc, fundCd ASC
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM UZM0UI t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} ORDER BY ymd DESC

SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.fund_nm AS fundNm , '' AS workGb , TO_CHAR(t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.af_gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , t1.mg_cd AS secCd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SZM0IA t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.fund_cd = #{fundCd}
